mappings.title: Canonical graph identity and membership
mappings.oracle: Hand-authored node/edge records including isolated nodes, loops, parallel relations and hidden membership.
mappings.gaps: Canonical round trips are scoped evidence; source-code mutation paths are not all mediated by a revisioned command boundary.
mappings.assumptions: One complete local document; stable string identities; supported native fields only.
mappings.failureConsequence: Hidden or parallel information lost or identities confused during viewing/export.

mappings.title: Native persistence and honest save status
mappings.oracle: Explicit fixture schema and original field values; rejected imports preserve the prior graph. Download initiation is not a durability oracle.
mappings.gaps: No crash-safe save, autosave or secure-erasure claim. Storage effects of the assembled local workflow need observation. Native YAML is a new format rather than a Java serialization clone.
mappings.assumptions: Explicit user file selection/export; format version 1; no durable-save acknowledgement from the OS.
mappings.failureConsequence: User believes unsaved memory is durable, or a save/load changes supported information.

mappings.title: Deliberate atomic editing
mappings.oracle: Independent field/end-point expectations, stale-object and injected insertion-failure cases.
mappings.gaps: Undo remains absent; command/revision coverage is partial. Invalid edits need systematic full-record preservation checks.
mappings.assumptions: Single-user edits; current object identities; ordinary allocation succeeds; rejected commands must remain atomic.
mappings.failureConsequence: Partial mutation, unintended edits or inability to recover intentional changes.

mappings.title: Graph navigation and focus ownership
mappings.oracle: Literal Java command bodies and key map, plus explicit current selection/text-focus rules.
mappings.gaps: OS-reserved chord delivery, assistive technology, touch and human discoverability remain unassessed.
mappings.assumptions: Application receives the event; explicit control/text focus takes precedence over graph focus.
mappings.failureConsequence: Commands target the wrong item, consume text input, or prevent accessible navigation.

mappings.title: Lens coordinate contracts
mappings.oracle: Analytic forward/inverse coordinates and pinned Java reference; fixed 1.5 horizontal stretch generalized to explicit factors.
mappings.gaps: Nonlinear/custom lenses do not imply exact invertibility or unconstrained collision clearance.
mappings.assumptions: Declared lens order and valid factors; custom lenses require separate contracts.
mappings.failureConsequence: Picking/editing disagrees with drawing or screen transforms alter semantic state.

mappings.title: Bounded layout and independent damping
mappings.oracle: Pinned upstream Java layout for ordinary forces; prescribed oscillator/drift inputs and analytic rectangle/disk fixtures for extensions.
mappings.gaps: No general workload/latency or arbitrary-graph convergence guarantee; import/render global resource limits still need assessment.
mappings.assumptions: Fixed seed, initial coordinates, visible membership, constraints and integration-step budget.
mappings.failureConsequence: Unbounded work, unreadable placement, stalled context or movement of protected nodes.

mappings.title: RFC and derived structural views
mappings.oracle: Explicit adjacency/occurrence/witness tables; source preservation; RFC paper equations and prescribed trees, not pixel recreation.
mappings.gaps: Preferred in-graph r=2 dependency-impact task awaits human observations. RFC is a reimplementation/extension of the paper, not a claimed Java function port.
mappings.assumptions: Explicit loaded/visible source scope; deterministic node/edge order and configured page budgets.
mappings.failureConsequence: Users infer false relationships or completeness from a derived or partial view.

mappings.title: Literal retrieval replacement
mappings.oracle: Hand-specified lexical fixtures and independent provider/graph ownership contracts.
mappings.gaps: Elasticlunr is intentionally not Lucene scoring parity; real-world relevance needs judged queries.
mappings.assumptions: Current eligible content snapshot; no query/result nodes in the indexed content corpus.
mappings.failureConsequence: Private content leaks across provider boundaries or unrelated source records enter ranking.

mappings.title: LDA retrieval and corrected legacy similarities
mappings.oracle: Owner-authorized binary harness on synthetic probability matrices, plus independent distance formulas. See retrieval parity record.
mappings.gaps: Source-only wrapper is not the missing Dirichlet implementation; binary hashes/oracle limits are pinned by the harness. No general topic/relevance-quality claim.
mappings.assumptions: Validated model matrices, vocabulary and corpus identity; declared distance metric and inference seed.
mappings.failureConsequence: Stale/mismatched model silently produces misleading similarities or ranking.

mappings.title: Graph query provenance and feedback
mappings.oracle: Explicit expected query/context/result roles, content membership and source freshness, including known corpus-fingerprint collision.
mappings.gaps: Imported result metadata is data, not trusted evidence. Exported findings do not establish domain truth.
mappings.assumptions: Accepted results belong to the live graph and exact eligible content snapshot.
mappings.failureConsequence: Retrieved associations masquerade as facts or feedback deletes ordinary relations.

mappings.title: Cancellation, replacement and teardown
mappings.oracle: Controlled workers and deferred reads delivered after cancellation/replacement/disposal; explicit active-owner expectations.
mappings.gaps: No wall-clock sleeps are an oracle for race freedom. Exhaustive scheduling and every UI lifecycle path are not covered.
mappings.assumptions: Worker/job ownership and source generations are checked; effects can be driven by a controlled scheduler.
mappings.failureConsequence: Old work mutates a new document or leaked workers/listeners repeat commands.

mappings.title: Local privacy and network isolation
mappings.oracle: Explicit allowed application requests and synthetic canary graph/query/model content; observe actual production browser effects.
mappings.gaps: Existing sanitizer/import checks are not end-to-end privacy evidence. Network, storage and logs need an integrated canary scenario; no encryption/secure-erasure claim.
mappings.assumptions: Application assets are served locally or from the trusted distribution; graph/query data must remain local.
mappings.failureConsequence: Private graph/query/model data leaves the device or persists without a declared policy.

mappings.title: Untrusted content and validation
mappings.oracle: Hostile synthetic labels, markup, URL protocols, malformed records and explicit expected rejection/inert display.
mappings.gaps: No complete threat-model or global parser resource-limit audit. Test hostile content in the production build as well as isolated helpers.
mappings.assumptions: Imported labels, markup, URLs and files are hostile even on the local device.
mappings.failureConsequence: Imported data executes code, triggers a network request or corrupts the accepted document.

mappings.title: Future server authority
mappings.oracle: Future server-side allowed/denied access, revision/conflict and partial-result fixtures. Client-only tests cannot validate authority.
mappings.gaps: Not implemented or accepted as an initial delivery capability. Authentication, tenant isolation, retention and concurrency policy require a separate specification.
mappings.assumptions: Future mode only; server boundary and authentication/authorization policies not yet specified.
mappings.failureConsequence: Unauthorized cross-user access or conflicting/partial remote data accepted as complete.

mappings.title: Architectural ownership and composition
mappings.oracle: Independent dependency rules, public export/constructor inventory, cold headless imports and original license texts.
mappings.gaps: Acyclic imports alone do not prove mutation ownership. Reproducible assembled-build evidence and independent review remain necessary.
mappings.assumptions: Public contracts are the supported composition boundary; browser effects must remain explicit.
mappings.failureConsequence: Duplicate state ownership, hidden effects or an assembled build behaves differently from checked modules.

mappings.title: Evidence and attribution
mappings.oracle: Original license bytes, pinned reference scenarios, exact inputs/versions and evidence hashes rather than test counts.
mappings.gaps: Repository fixtures and experiment reports are scoped records, not blanket conformance or independent review.
mappings.assumptions: Pinned inputs and original attribution texts are available; toolchain/environment are recorded.
mappings.failureConsequence: Unsupported correctness claims or missing notices in the actual distribution.
